summary: Comprehensive backend API testing completed for TRIRARA TUNGGAL PUTRA excavator rental operations app. All 55 backend tests passed (100% success rate). Tested: Authentication, Security (admin vs operator), HM Janggal detection & settings, Pengingat Piutang (aging, settings, preview, run, cron), Laporan Mingguan (settings, preview, run, cron), WhatsApp simulation (inbound text), Outbox simulation, Backup & restore, and Regression tests for stable features (Units, Operations, Pengurus, WA basic endpoints, Daily summary).

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working correctly. WhatsApp is in SIMULATION mode as designed (no Meta credentials configured).

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend testing not completed due to time constraints. Backend API integration is fully functional and tested.

Piutang Cron: Endpoint requires WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET bearer token, duplicate webhook ID detection working
Weekly Settings: Validation working (min 1 recipient, phone validation)
Weekly Preview & Run: Preview shows correct week data, manual run creates simulated messages, history tracking
Weekly Cron: Endpoint requires WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET bearer token
WA Simulation: Inbound text simulation working, validation for phone and empty text
Outbox: Simulated messages tracked correctly, counts accurate
Backup: Info endpoint working (23-24 collections, user_sessions excluded), download endpoint accessible
